datasheet_identity.title: AP3003 N and P-Channel Enhancement Mosfet

extraction_notes: The supplied datasheet defines both N-channel and P-channel devices under the AP3003 name. This schema instance records the N-channel polarity and N-channel characteristics; the P-channel rows and plots are present on p. 3 and p. 7-p. 9 but cannot be represented in the single-polarity schema object.
Output, transfer, and capacitance curves were manually digitized from the N-channel typical plots on p. 5.
The electrical characteristics table publishes gate-charge, switching-time, body-diode-current, IDSS, and IGSS values; this extraction schema has no fields for those quantities.
Correction retry: p. 2 and Fig. 6 label capacitance in pF; Ciss/Coss/Crss scalars and the Crss curve points are converted to SI F by 1/1000, retaining the stated VGS = 0 V and f = 1 MHz conditions.
